content.text: Nigerian creators often face significant barriers when trying to monetize their digital products. With Stripe only operating in 46 out of 195 countries, many are locked out of using popular platforms like PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy. These restrictions create an urgent need for reliable alternatives that empower creators to maintain full control over their business operations without relying on conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-8|payment]] processors that exclude them.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy provide similar functionalities for digital sales, including payment processing, product delivery, and customer management. However, for Nigerian creators, these platforms either lack availability or impose excessive restrictions that limit their ability to operate freely. In contrast, sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-solana-payments-digital-products-stripe-3|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] solutions like COREMERCH offer a robust alternative that enables creators to set up fully operational stores without the restrictions imposed by traditional platforms, allowing them to accept payments in over 300 [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-step-step-deployment-3|Crypto Payments]]currencies.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal's exclusion of countries like Nigeria and Pakistan means creators often find themselves without effective tools to sell their products. PayPal can even suspend accounts, holding funds for up to 180 days without appeal, causing significant financial strain. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure does not exclude users based on geography. By utilizing tools like NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can bypass these restrictions, ensuring they can operate continuously, regardless of where they are located.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Traditional payment platforms often involve hidden fees and slow transaction times, especially for international payments. Stripe charges various fees and may delay payouts based on account reviews. In contrast, NOWPayments offers quick on-chain payment verification with only a 0.5% fee, creating a more predictable cost structure for creators. Additionally, the recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON have transaction fees under $0.10, far cheaper than conventional options, ensuring that creators keep more of their earnings.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure liberates creators from platform restrictions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With conventional platforms, users often give up ownership of their data and face limitations on automation. For instance, once a product is sold through Gumroad or PayPal, the creator has limited control over customer data and sales processes. COREMERCH's solutions emphasize full ownership; creators retain all data and can automate processes through free tools like Google Apps Script. This means not only do creators maintain control, but they can also ensure a seamless experience for their customers.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When choosing a commerce stack, consider your product range and technical comfort level. For those new to digital sales, the Sovereign Starter Stack is an accessible option, while more established creators might find the Edge Commerce Stack ideal for scalability. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers an all-in-one solution, combining various blueprints and templates to ensure you have the right infrastructure in place to build, deploy, and grow your digital store effortlessly.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is unavailable, you can utilize sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions like COREMERCH. This architecture allows you to set up an online store that processes payments in various cryptocurrencies, completely bypassing the restrictions of conventional platforms. By leveraging free tools, you ensure full ownership and control over your digital products.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
